_comment: Bambu Lab P1S. Connection details are NOT in this file and must not be added: the IP, LAN access code and serial are per-printer and per-person, they live in the encrypted config store as BAMBU_IP / BAMBU_CODE / BAMBU_SERIAL, and a profile is committed to the repository. Issue #73.

_sources.machine_geometry: Bambu Lab P1S published specification: 256 x 256 x 256 mm build volume, 0.4 mm stock hotend, enclosed, textured PEI plate. Verified against the printer in the room (owner, 2026-09-09).
_sources.firmware_verified_against: 01.09.01.00 — the version on the machine. Bambu tightens third-party LAN access between releases and cannot be downgraded, so this profile is a claim about that firmware.
_sources.temperatures: NOT YET CONFIRMED against Bambu Studio's stock P1S + PLA Basic profile. 220/60 are conventional PLA values and safe to start from, but the issue asks for vendor-derived numbers and nobody has opened Bambu Studio yet. On the hardware checklist in the PR.
_sources.start_end_gcode: NOT YET CONFIRMED. Deliberately minimal and deliberately NOT an imitation of Bambu's own macros. Printing a raw gcode_file means this start block is what runs, so the machine's bed-levelling and purge sequence must be pasted here from Bambu Studio before a real print. Writing a plausible-looking imitation would be worse than leaving it short, because it would look finished.

machine_start_gcode:
M140 S{material_bed_temperature} ; bed on
M104 S{material_print_temperature} ; hotend on
G28 ; home
M190 S{material_bed_temperature} ; wait for bed
M109 S{material_print_temperature} ; wait for hotend
G92 E0 ; reset extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; lift
G1 X5 Y20 Z0.3 F5000 ; to the purge line
G1 X5 Y200 Z0.3 F1500 E15 ; purge
G1 X5.4 Y200 Z0.3 F5000 ; step over
G1 X5.4 Y20 Z0.3 F1500 E30 ; purge back
G92 E0 ; reset extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; lift
machine_end_gcode:
G91 ; relative
G1 E-2 F2700 ; retract
G1 Z10 F3000 ; lift
G90 ; absolute
G1 X128 Y250 F6000 ; present the plate
M104 S0 ; hotend off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M106 S0 ; fan off
M84 X Y E ; steppers off, Z held
